_doc: Machine-readable index of shared components. Agents: look here before writing UI. `when` says the need it answers; `props` lists the ones that matter. A test checks every entry still exists.

components.name: DataTable
components.when: Show, sort, filter, group, page and edit many records; bulk edit; export

components.name: Editable
components.when: Edit one value in place (detail fields, titles, cards)

components.name: FieldEditor
components.when: Just the editor control (inside custom panels); prefer Editable

components.name: BulkEditPanel
components.when: Bulk edit outside DataTable (DataTable already includes it)

components.name: PageHeader
components.when: Top of every page: title (can be Editable), description, crumbs, actions

components.name: Panel
components.when: A titled card/section

components.name: Btn
components.when: Any button

components.name: Badge
components.when: Status chip

components.name: Modal
components.when: Blocking dialog with a form or detail

components.name: Drawer
components.when: Side panel for a record or filters

components.name: ConfirmDelete
components.when: Irreversible actions only (reversible ones get an undo toast)

components.name: Menu
components.when: Overflow and action menus

components.name: Tabs
components.when: Switch between views of one page

components.name: EmptyState
components.when: No data yet or no results: one primary action

components.name: Skeleton
components.when: Loading placeholder (not a spinner)

components.name: Alert
components.when: Inline notice or error

components.name: Pagination
components.when: Paged lists outside DataTable

components.name: Field
components.when: Label + hint + error wrapper for any input

components.name: TextInput
components.when: Single-line text

components.name: TextArea
components.when: Multi-line text

components.name: Select
components.when: Pick one from a short list

components.name: Combobox
components.when: Pick from a long list, or tags

components.name: Segmented
components.when: Pick one of 2-4 options

components.name: Switch
components.when: Boolean setting

components.name: Checkbox
components.when: Boolean in a list or form

components.name: Icon
components.when: Line icons from @belikh/jupiter-graphics

components.name: Spot
components.when: Spot illustration for empty and error states

components.name: createCollection
components.when: The mock data source for a page (async, latency, injectable failure)

components.name: useCollection
components.when: Live rows + loading state + a save that fits DataTable onCommit

components.name: usePrefs
components.when: Theme, density, language, editCommit, toast (with undo)

components.name: useDraft
components.when: Keep form state across reloads, with a restored notice and discard

components.name: useAutosave
components.when: Save a form shortly after edits stop (no Save button); returns status, error, retry

components.name: SaveStatusText
components.when: The Saving / Saved / error + Retry text for autosave

components.name: useUnsavedGuard
components.when: Warn before leaving a page with unsaved changes (route links and reload)

components.name: usePublishSelection
components.when: Publish checked-row actions so the command palette lists them (DataTable does this already)

components.name: parseDateShortcut
components.when: Turn 'tomorrow', '+3d', 'next mon' into an ISO date (date editors already accept these)

components.name: usePasteFill
components.when: Let any form accept pasted 'Label: value' lines or a tab-separated row

components.name: useFieldErrors
components.when: Validate on blur and summarise on submit, with FormSummary

components.name: FormSummary
components.when: The error list shown after a failed submit, with jump links

components.name: SameAsAbove
components.when: A 'same as above' checkbox for repeated address-style blocks

components.name: Disclosure
components.when: Hide advanced fields behind a toggle (progressive disclosure)

components.name: SyncStatus
components.when: Offline, 'N changes pending' and stale-data indicator for a useCollection

components.name: ConflictPrompt
components.when: Keep mine / take theirs when a row changed under you (useCollection.conflict)

components.name: PageSkeleton
components.when: Suspense fallback for a page: header, tiles and a table, no layout shift

components.name: pushUndo
components.when: Register a reversible edit so Ctrl/Cmd+Z and the palette can undo and redo it (Editable and bulk edit already do)

components.name: Section
components.when: A titled block on a page: mono kicker over an h2, then content (the documentation look)

components.name: Callout
components.when: A short info, warn or danger note with a text prefix (the generated .jp-callout markup)

components.name: KeyValue
components.when: A mono key / value list for a few facts

components.name: SimpleTable
components.when: A small static sortable table in plain .jp-table markup; use DataTable for editable or large data

components.name: StatTile
components.when: A KPI tile: label, big value, delta and a sparkline. Use instead of hand-written stat markup

components.name: LineChart
components.when: Time series line or area chart with tooltips and a data-table toggle

components.name: BarChart
components.when: Categorical bars (horizontal or vertical)

components.name: Donut
components.when: Part-to-whole ring with a centre label

components.name: Terrain
components.when: A contour map of linked items: each item is a hill (its height says how developed or important it is), links are dotted trails, placed by links or by meaning. Real links, plain SVG, works on the server
props: nodes (id, label, href, height, icon, x, y, vector)
